name: Pallof Press
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle at your chest with both hands.
Step away to create tension and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without rotating.
Bring the handle back to your chest.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: An anti-rotation core exercise where you press a cable away from your chest without letting your torso twist.
